claims.statement: Tom Allen left St. Louis for Detroit with Jack Looney and two or three others to see the Mace and O'Baldwin fight.
claims.excerpt: boarded the Toledo, Wabash and Western train last evenirg,; for Detroit.

notes: No fight for Allen: the Mace and O'Baldwin bout is not his, and the article says the fight was reported but not confirmed. Hint matches the text.
